title: Beyond the Biological Bottleneck: Could Intelligence Emerge Directly from Nature?
description: A theoretical framework separating physical computation, adaptive capability, minimal agency and functional intelligence from causal origin. Includes a conditional functional non-identifiability proposition and a synthetic demonstration. No empirical extraterrestrial observations or biological samples are used.
